question: Which of the following is the largest tributary of the Indus river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chenab River.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chenab River** is the **largest tributary** of the **Indus River.**
 
• The Chenab River originates from the Himalayas in Himachal Pradesh</strong&
